ai_summary: AAVAS FINANCIERS LIMITED has scheduled routine one-on-one physical meetings with existing and proposed investors/analysts on July 29 and 30, 2026, in Mumbai. The company explicitly states that discussions will be based solely on publicly available information, ensuring no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. This indicates standard investor relations engagement with no immediate material market impact or red flags, as all discussion materials are already accessible to the public.
